perspective: Positive white_cp favors White. Null white_cp is a mate score in the deep records; mate gives distance. The broad screen uses +/-100000 for mate and must not be read as ordinary centipawns.
scope: First 15 White moves (or fewer) in all 130 selected games, all 22 diagram positions, six restricted-move comparisons, four 10M-node diagram checks and four additional targeted positions. No full-game engine audit.
